title: Research works – and the Global South should be part of it: gigaCCS at COP31
summary: gigaCCS reports on its participation at COP31, where Centre Director Mona Mølnvik said Norway has shown CCS works at full scale. She called for the knowledge to be shared and for more support for research cooperation with the Global South.
why_it_matters: Signals the research agenda and international positioning of Norway's main CCS research centre, a likely partner and data source for Nordic CCS chain studies.
